run.command: strata bench run --profile flashnext-iq3s-bench2 --track custom --track-notes Strata 0.2.11 release binary (Terminal install.sh), macOS 27.2, Mac Studio with Apple M2 Ultra (24-core CPU, 60-core GPU), 128 GB, internal SSD. Setup: strata launch --model-path (IQ3_S shards from ISTA-DASLab/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-GSQ-RCO-GGUF, downloaded with hf) --context 32k --vision off --tune skip; DFlash2 drafter as set up by launch; profile created from the installed run config with port set to 8086. Background: Ollama 0.40.13 with qwen3.8:27b-mlx (27 GB) loaded but idle, Home Assistant in Docker, small house services. --quantization IQ3_S --background Ollama 0.40.13: qwen3.8:27b-mlx loaded, idle --background Home Assistant (Docker/OrbStack), idle --output human
